text: Have you ever pretended not to see a message so you would not have to reply?
Have you ever searched your own name online?
Have you ever blamed someone else for something you did?
Have you ever laughed at a joke you did not understand?
Do you sing when nobody is listening?
Have you ever talked to yourself in the mirror?
Have you ever sent a message and immediately regretted it?
Would you reveal your last search to your friends right now?
Have you ever acted confident while you were completely nervous?
Have you ever had a crush on someone your friends would never guess?
Do you still remember your first crush?
Have you ever reread an old romantic conversation?
Have you ever kept an important secret from your best friend?
Would you lend your best friend your phone unlocked for one hour?
Have you ever been jealous of a friend's success?
Have you ever hidden a purchase from your family?
Do you have a favorite family member?
Have you ever pretended to be asleep to avoid a family conversation?
